messages.author: 75342af0da3315d6
messages.subject: Open Shapefile in Shiny App -  fileInput
parts:
Hi Shiny community,

I am trying open a shapefile in Shiny app, and I couldn't do it.

Someone know what is wrong in my code?


require(shiny)
require(maptools)

runApp(list(
  ui = bootstrapPage(
    fileInput('inputdata', 'Input shapefile',accept='.shp'),
    plotOutput("SHPplot")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
    
    output$SHPplot <-  renderPlot({
      
      myshape<- input$inputdata
      if (is.null(myshape)) 
        return(NULL)       
      
      shape<-readShapePoly("myshape$datapath")
      plot(shape)
      
    })
  }
))

Thanks a lot!

messages.author: f8b7c6eae8e5aa1d
messages.subject: Re: Open Shapefile in Shiny App - fileInput
parts:
Hi,

This can't work :)
A shapefile isn't just the .shp file that you're uploading, it need the other companion files, like the dbf, the shx, the prj etc.
So, here, you only upload a single file : you need to modify your fileinput to download all the necessary files.

Robin

messages.subject: Re: Open Shapefile in Shiny App - fileInput
parts:
Hi,

This doesn't work as shiny, when uploading, renames the files.
So, I can't think to another solution than renaming back the files.
Here's a working example :
https://gist.github.com/RCura/9587685

You can run it using :  runGist("https://gist.github.com/RCura/9587685")

This example is kinda ugly, but gives you the idea, and it's working-ish :)

HTH,

Robin

messages.author: 75342af0da3315d6
messages.subject: RE: Open Shapefile in Shiny App - fileInput
parts:
Hi Robin,
thanks for the e-mail and the solution.
I did a solution similar your:

runApp(list(
  ui = bootstrapPage(
    fileInput('inputdata', 'Input shapefile',accept=c('.shp','.dbf','.sbn','.sbx','.shx',".prj"), multiple=TRUE),

plotOutput("SHPplot")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
    
    output$SHPplot <-  renderPlot({
      
      myshape<- input$inputdata
      if (is.null(myshape)) 
        return(NULL)

dir<-dirname(myshape[1,4])
      
    for ( i in 1:nrow(myshape)) {
    file.rename(myshape[i,4], paste0(dir,"/",myshape[i,1]))}
    
    getshp <- list.files(dir, pattern="*.shp", full.names=TRUE)
      shape<-readShapePoly(getshp)
      plot(shape)
      
    })
  }
))

Thanks you so much,
Best Regards
Carlos A. Silva
